note: Exemplar selections for the seven replacement corpora. Keys address a verbatim passage in the new corpus built by build_corpora.py; annotations are ours and describe the construction.

the-crisis-editorial-page: the standing head, then the claim, then the cheap explanation refused in the next paragraph
an objection quoted in full from the person who made it, then answered on its own terms
congressional-research-service-issue-rep: what the thing is, what was decided, and what is still open, in that order
a contested claim attributed to the people making it, with the mechanism spelled out
faa-airplane-flying-handbook: numbered actions in the order a hand performs them, each carrying its reason
the hazard and the authority for it stated before any procedure begins
nhc-forecast-discussions: the measurement first, the call it supports second, the forecast third
what the guidance agrees on and what it does not, both said plainly
lamb-elia-essays: a person introduced through one quoted sentence of her own and then circled
an admission opens the essay and the digression that follows becomes the argument
anderson-winesburg-ohio: the place given in one long sentence, then the man inside it moving
feeling stays in what the characters do, and the paragraph closes on a line of speech
high-fantasy: the chronicler addresses the reader, sets the flaw in the fortune, and lets the scene run on
the room is inventoried object by object until the inventory turns into weather
